0.why: src/Observer.cpp:134, getVoltage() takes channel 0 only for drawing; src/Observer.cpp:231, the trace is scaled by 0.05 so 10V is half the lane

comment: The trigger scan does walk the channels of the first patched input (src/Observer.cpp:105-111), but only channel 0 of each jack is ever drawn, so poly is false for what a reader sees. The inputs get no family: a scope shows whatever you give it. The time knob and the trigger lamp are both ParamWidgets and both have census positions, so both are clickable and both get a line; the time knob is a transparent 120 by 300 widget laid over the whole display. Nothing on this panel is lettered except the module name. Layout is at src/Observer.cpp:358-391.
